title: FIRE360
summary: FIRE360 is a Python library for generating local explanations of black-box tabular ML models by training surrogate models on synthetic-data neighborhoods around each sample. It generates these synthetic datasets using SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (and the standalone ctgan package), run directly to build the explanation neighborhoods.
